name: Design (HTML/CSS medium)
description: Produce visual designs by authoring HTML/CSS with best practices for human visual consumption, then convert to the delivery format (web, PDF, image, docx, pptx).
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When producing a visual design — page, component, layout, mockup, report, one-pager, email, or slide content — authored as HTML/CSS and converted to the delivery format. For governing a design system/brand (tokens, component libraries, cross-medium audits), use design-ops.
